title: Vacation in Bhutan | FREE Excursion to Taktsang
highlights: Explore Bhutan’s tranquil charm, from Paro’s cliffside Tiger’s Nest Monastery to Thimphu’s cultural gems like the Buddha Dordenma and ancient temples.
Admire the intricate Buddhist art at the National Memorial Chorten, a revered stupa, where you can witness traditional rituals and soak-in the peaceful surroundings.
Enjoy a trek to Taktsang Monastery, clinging to a cliff, and explore its revered halls, rich with Bhutanese spiritual heritage and awe-inspiring vistas.
Pay your respects at one of Bhutan's oldest temples, Kyichu Lhakhang, and admire its traditional architecture, offering a peaceful retreat.
Spot Bhutan's national animal, the takin, in its natural habitat at Motithang Takin Preserve, where these unique creatures wander freely in a serene setting.
overview:
About the tour:
Embark on a transformative 5-day journey through Bhutan, where each day unfolds like a cherished chapter. From Paro's ancient monasteries to the vibrant heart of Thimphu and a soul-stirring visit to Taktsang, the Tiger's Nest Monastery, this tour isn't just about places; it's a dance with Bhutan's essence. Let the warmth of Bhutanese hospitality and the sacred air of Taktsang seep into your soul. This isn't your average trip; it's an intimate rendezvous with the magic of Bhutan, where tradition and modernity coalesce seamlessly.

Duration: 5 Days, 4 Nights
Start Point: Paro International Airport
End Point: Paro International Airport

know_before_you_go: Carry a valid ID proof, as it may be required for entry to certain attractions or accommodations.
Ask your local guide to help you purchase a SIM on arrival, as Bhutan supports 2 networks: B-Mobile SIM and TashiCell.
Travelers aren't expected to wear the traditional kira, but you should make sure your clothing covers your arms and legs when entering a Dzong.
Buy a visa for every night you spend in Bhutan.
It is wise to carry enough cash, especially for remote areas in the Ngultrum (BTN) currency.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Paro | Transfer to Thimphu | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Paro! Upon your arrival at Paro Airport, head to the immigration office for your travel permit. Then, get driven to your hotel in Thimphu. Check in & spend the day at leisure. You can explore Ludrong Memorial Garden, featuring 50 species of native Bhutanese plants & herbs. Experience Bhutanese culture at Simply Bhutan & witness live demonstrations of traditional crafts. You can also relax in Deer Park, modeled after India’s Deer Park. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, you'll be driven to explore Thimphu. Visit the National Memorial Chorten & admire its religious paintings. Next, admire the 51.5-meter-tall Buddha Dordenma, housing the world’s largest Buddha statue. At Motithang Preserve, you might spot Bhutan's national animal. Then, explore Tashichho Dzong, a stunning fortress housing government offices, & Simtokha Dzong, the oldest dzong in Bhutan. Later, you can shop for souvenirs at the Handicrafts Emporium before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Paro | Paro Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, you'll be driven to Paro. Upon arrival, explore Drukgyel Dzong, which served as a stronghold against Tibetan invasions. Next, gaze at the majestic Mt. Jhomolhari, Bhutan’s second-highest peak at 7,314 meters, known for its stunning beauty and cultural significance. Visit Kyichu Lhakhang, one of Bhutan's oldest temples, dating back to the 7th century, believed to hold spiritual power. Afterward, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hike to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
days.desc: Today, begin your journey at Ta Dzong, a watchtower that serves as a national museum. Next, visit Rinpung Dzong. Then, visit Tiger’s Nest parking lot, where your 7 km hike to the Taktsang Monastery. As you ascend through lush pine forests adorned with colorful prayer flags, take in the views of the Paro Valley. Upon arrival at the monastery, explore its prayer wheels, meditation caves, and intricate murals dedicated to Guru Rinpoche. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
